intent.summary: Presents a repeatable, ordered collection of data-backed items with reusable item semantics.
useWhen: Item identity and data-driven repetition matter
Selection or virtualization may be required
avoidWhen: A small fixed group has no collection behavior

semantics.childPolicy: an item template plus a data source; optional headers, footers, or sections
semantics.sizing: viewport-constrained with item extents determined by template and layout policy
semantics.ordering: data-source order unless an explicit sort is declared

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Ordered data source with stable item identity.

attributes.name: itemTemplate
attributes.description: Pattern subtree instantiated for each item.

constraints.message: Data-backed items require stable identity for updates and selection.

accessibility.nameSource: visible collection label or application-defined name
accessibility.focusBehavior: items use platform collection navigation and selection semantics
notes: Expose item position, set size when known, and selection state.

mappings.strategy: Separate collection data, identity, template, selection, and layout.
Use ListView for selection and collection behavior; ItemsRepeater for custom layout.
caveats: ItemsRepeater does not supply selection semantics by itself.

mappings.strategy: Map through Qt Quick or Qt Widgets constructs using the same layout intent and accessibility contract.
caveats: Qt Quick and Qt Widgets differ in sizing, ownership, and event wiring.
